decisions.response: The formal response will document that Rowan's approved hearing-processing accommodation was not provided during the meetings in question, and that this unmet accommodation was substantially connected to the four observed incidents of interrupting and dismissing colleagues. The response will not initiate a formal warning. Instead, the response will require: (1) immediate implementation of live captions and elimination of rapid round-robin questioning in all team meetings, (2) a 30-day coaching plan with exactly two documented check-ins to address any residual conduct concerns independent of the accommodation gap, and (3) one facilitated repair meeting between Mina and Rowan as Mina offered. The consultation note from Victor's policy consultation will be added to the case file.

commitments.detail: Live captions and no rapid round-robin questioning will be provided in all future team meetings per Rowan's approved hearing-processing accommodation.

A 30-day coaching plan with exactly two documented check-ins will be initiated to address any conduct concerns independent of the accommodation gap, per policy guidance for a first substantiated conduct pattern of this type.
One facilitated repair meeting will be held between Mina and Rowan as part of the resolution process.
Victor's policy consultation note confirming the 30-day coaching plan requirement with two documented check-ins will be added to the case file promptly.
